speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Praetor neutralized. Battlements clear. The summit flak arrays have fallen silent.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Praetor neutralized. Battlements clear. The summit flak arrays have fallen silent.

speaker: TITAN
text: Heavy armor, weak servos. Now those blast doors look less welcoming. Think they heard what happened to their guardian?
subtitle: TITAN: Heavy armor, weak servos. Now those blast doors look less welcoming. Think they heard what happened to their guardian?

speaker: OCEANUS
text: Pressure falling, temperature rising. That storm around the summit is getting tighter. This is not normal weather.
subtitle: OCEANUS: Pressure falling, temperature rising. That storm around the summit is getting tighter. This is not normal weather.

speaker: SURYA
text: It is a power siphon. He is drawing energy straight into the throne room. My shields can feel the distortion.
subtitle: SURYA: It is a power siphon. He is drawing energy straight into the throne room. My shields can feel the distortion.

speaker: AURA
text: The dissonance behind those doors is deafening. He knows we are here. He has stopped hiding.
subtitle: AURA: The dissonance behind those doors is deafening. He knows we are here. He has stopped hiding.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: Gate relays unlocked. The Praetor key was the last barrier. Releasing the hydraulic bolts. Three. Two. One.
subtitle: MIRAGE: Gate relays unlocked. The Praetor key was the last barrier. Releasing the hydraulic bolts. Three. Two. One.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Blast doors opening. Throne chamber confirmed. Lethal energy readings beyond the threshold. Proceed together.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Blast doors opening. Throne chamber confirmed. Lethal energy readings beyond the threshold. Proceed together.

speaker: SURYA
text: From the flooded ruins to the clouds. All this way, all these people depending on us. We finish it here.
subtitle: SURYA: From the flooded ruins to the clouds. All this way, all these people depending on us. We finish it here.

speaker: KAITO
text: We set out to free this city. We finish together. Axiom Force, draw steel. Behind these doors is Judgment Day.
subtitle: KAITO: We set out to free this city. We finish together. Axiom Force, draw steel. Behind these doors is Judgment Day.
